IntoxicatingElixir.description: The relic bearer deals <style="Stat_CritDamage">+{[extraCritDmg]} Crit Damage</style> for each unit within range {[range]} that is <style="Debuff_Pinned">Suppressed</style>, <style="Debuff_Stunned">Stunned</style>, <style="Debuff_Taunted">Taunted</style>, or <style="ThrillSeekers">Thrilled</style>, up to a maximum of {[nrOfUnits]} times. This bonus is doubled if the relic bearer is at or below <style="Stat_Health">{[healthPct]}% Health</style>.

InvocationOfMachineVengeance.description:
Summons <style="Stat">{[nrOfSummons]}</style> <style="Summon"><style="Faction_AdeptusMechanicus">Tech-Priest Enginseers</style></style> at the bottom of the map. Then adds <style="Stat">{[effectLevel]}</style> level of <style="Buff_MachineVengeance">Machine Vengeance</style> to all friendly <style="Mechanical">Mechanical</style> units on the battlefield.

Tech-Priest Enginseer stats:
<style="Stat_Health">{[summonHp]} Health</style>
<style="Stat_Damage">{[summonDmg]} Damage</style>
<style="Stat_Armor">{[summonArmor]} Armour</style>

IronkinSteeljack.description:
Summons an <style="Summon"><style="Faction_LeaguesOfVotann">Ironkin Steeljack</style></style> in a free adjacent hex. The Ironkin Steeljack can immediately attack, but cannot move this turn.

Ironkin Steeljack stats:
<style="Stat_Health">{[summonHp]} Health</style>
<style="Stat_Damage">{[summonDmg]} Damage</style>
<style="Stat_Armor">{[summonArmor]} Armour</style>

ItItches.description:
<style="Debuff_Pinned">Suppresses</style> and <style="Displacement">pushes</style> an adjacent enemy unit and all enemy units adjacent to both the target and the <style="Faction_Tyranids">Parasite of Mortrex</style> one hex backwards. Enemy <style="Steppable">steppables</style> on affected hexes are destroyed. Then summons a <style="Summon"><style="Faction_Tyranids">Ripper Swarm</style></style> in each hex vacated by this ability. The <style="Summon"><style="Faction_Tyranids">Ripper Swarms</style></style> can immediately attack. The <style="Faction_Tyranids">Parasite of Mortrex</style> may move again after activating this ability.

Ripper Swarm stats:
<style="Stat_Health">{[summonHp]} Health</style>
<style="Stat_Damage">{[summonDmg]} Damage</style>
<style="Stat_Armor">{[summonArmor]} Armour</style>

ItsGonnaBlow.description:
If this unit is <style="Overkill">Overkilled</style> the ammo box explodes, dealing <style="Stat_Hits">{[nrOfHits]}x</style> <style="DMG_Blast">{[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Blast Damage</style> to all adjacent hexes.

{[S/AbilityDamageExplanation]}

JakhalStimms.description: Deals {[nrOfHits]}x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Physical Damage to an adjacent enemy and all other enemies adjacent to both Macer and the target. Then Macer loses {[hpPct]}% of his current Health. Using Jakhal Stimms does not end Macer's turn.

KardiocoreGalvanus.description: The relic bearer deals <style="Stat_CritDamage">+{[extraCritDmg]} Crit Damage</style> for each friendly adjacent <style="Mechanical">Mechanical</style> unit.

KillMaimBurn.description: Deals <style="Stat_Hits">{[nrOfHits]}x</style> <style="DMG_Piercing">{[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Piercing Damage</style> to an adjacent enemy. Then performs a second attack targeting an adjacent enemy, dealing <style="Stat_Hits">{[nrOfHits_2]}x</style> <style="DMG_Eviscerate">{[minDmg_2]}-{[maxDmg_2]} Eviscerating Damage</style>. Then performs a third attack targeting an enemy within range {[range]}, dealing <style="Stat_Hits">{[nrOfHits_3]}x</style> <style="DMG_Plasma">{[minDmg_3]}-{[maxDmg_3]} Plasma Damage</style>. All attacks prioritise the same target until it is killed and then prioritise kills.

KissOfDeath.description: The <style="Faction_Aeldari">Harlequin Player</style> disappears and deals <style="Stat_Hits">{[nrOfHits]}x</style> <style="DMG_Direct">{[dmg]} Direct Damage</style> to an adjacent enemy, and up to {[maxAdjacentTargets]} additional enemies adjacent to a previous target, then it reappears in a hex adjacent to the last target hit.

KustomForceFieldReworked.description: All friendly adjacent units have <style="Stat_Armor">+{[extraArmor]} Armour</style>. <style="Faction_Orks">Gibbascrapz</style> and other friendly adjacent <style="Faction_Orks">Orks</style> have <style="Stat_Armor">+{[extraArmor_2]} Armour</style> instead and ignore <style="Battle_Fatigue">Battle Fatigue</style>, if they have it.

Lakrimae.description: <style="Faction_DeathGuard">Typhus'</style> <style="NormalAttack">normal melee attacks</style> add <style="Tile_Contamination">Contamination</style> to the target's hex. During his turn, when a non-mechanical enemy unit within Typhus' <style="ContagionsOfNurgle">Contagion</style> aura is killed, he summons a <style="Summon"><style="Faction_DeathGuard">Poxwalker</style></style> in the hex of the defeated unit, as long as there are less than {[nrOfUnits]} friendly Poxwalkers on the battlefield. The Poxwalkers have <style="Stat_Health">{[summonHp]} Health</style> and <style="Stat_Damage">{[summonDmg]} Damage</style>.

LashOfTorment.description: Deals<style="Stat_Hits">{[nrOfHits]}x</style> <style="DMG_Eviscerate">{[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Eviscerating Damage</style> to an enemy unit within range {[range]}. If the target is not already adjacent to <style="Faction_EmperorsChildren">Lucius</style>, it is then <style="Displacement">pulled</style> 1 hex towards him if possible, and can be pulled over any elevation but not through impassable terrain. If the target is adjacent to Lucius after the attack, it is also <style="Debuff_Taunted">Taunted</style> by him for <style="STAT">{[nrOfRounds]}</style> rounds.

LeadingTheCharge.description:
If <style="Faction_AstraMilitarum">Dreir</style> has not moved, he gains <style="Buff_Infiltrate">Infiltrate</style> until the end of this turn and <style="Charging">charges</style> an enemy target that has a free adjacent hex within movement range {[range]}, dealing <style="Stat_Hits">{[nrOfHits]}x</style> <style="DMG_Power">{[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Power Damage</style> to it. Then, summons up to <style="Stat">{[nrOfSummons]}</style> <style="Summon"><style="Faction_AstraMilitarum">Death Riders</style></style> in free adjacent hexes that can immediately attack enemies in range. All attacks triggered by this ability have <style="Piercing_Ratio">+{[extraPierceRatio]}% pierce ratio</style> for each friendly unit that has been defeated this battle. 

Death Rider stats:
<style="Stat_Health">{[summonHp]} Health</style>
<style="Stat_Damage">{[summonDmg]} Damage</style>
<style="Stat_Armor">{[summonArmor]} Armour</style>

LegacyOfCombat.description: After performing his first attack each turn, <style="Faction_Custodes">Kariyan</style> performs an additional attack. If he is adjacent to an enemy <style="Big_Target">Big Target</style>, this attack deals <style="Stat_Hits">{[nrOfHits_2]}x</style> <style="DMG_Piercing">{[minDmg_2]}-{[maxDmg_2]} Piercing Damage</style> to it. If there is no adjacent enemy <style="Big_Target">Big Target</style>, <style="Faction_Custodes">Kariyan</style> deals <style="Stat_Hits">{[nrOfHits]}x</style> <style="DMG_Power">{[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Power Damage</style> to each adjacent enemy instead.

LegendaryCommander.description: Enemies receive <style="Stat_Damage">+{[extraDmg]} Damage</style> if they are adjacent to any friendly unit that has used an active ability this turn. If the affected enemies are also adjacent to <style="Faction_Custodes">Trajann</style>, friendly <style="Character">Characters</style> score <style="STAT">{[nrOfHits]}</style> additional <style="Stat_Hits">hits</style> against them with their first attack that is not a <style="NormalAttack">normal attack</style>.

LightImUp.description: After performing a <style="NormalAttack">normal attack</style>, <style="Faction_Orks">Boss Gulgortz</style> performs a second attack against the same enemy, dealing <style="Stat_Hits">{[nrOfHits]}x</style> <style="DMG_Projectile">{[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Projectile Damage</style>. If the target is defeated, leftover hits are allocated to any random enemy target within {[range]} hexes.

LightOfSanguinius.description: If <style="Faction_BloodAngels">Dante</style> has not moved, he gains <style="Buff_Infiltrate">Infiltrate</style> until the end of this turn, then <style="Charging">charges</style> an enemy target that has a free adjacent hex within movement range {[range]} and deals <style="Stat_Hits">{[nrOfHits]}x</style> <style="DMG_Melta">{[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Melta Damage</style> to it. The target and enemy units surrounding it deal <style="Stat_Damage">-{[dmgReductionPct]}% Damage</style> for {[nrOfRounds]} round. This effect is doubled if they attack friendly units that are at or below <style="Stat_Health">{[healthPct]}% Health</style>.

LionHelmRelic.description: Friendly units adjacent to <style="Faction_DarkAngels">Azrael</style> block an additional <style="Stat_Block">+{[blockDmg]} Damage</style>. At the end of Azrael's turn, if there is no friendly <style="Summon"><style="Faction_DarkAngels">Watcher in the Dark</style></style> on the battlefield, he has a <style="Stat_Chance">{[chance]}% chance</style> to summon a Watcher in the Dark in a free adjacent hex.

LivingLightning.description:
After moving, deals <style="Stat_Hits">{[nrOfHits]}x</style> <style="DMG_Direct">{[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Direct Damage</style> to a random enemy within range 2.
If <style="Faction_Necrons">Thutmose</style> does not move, then this ability triggers at the end of his turn.

Loki_SwoopingHawk.description:
Flies over and deals a wave of damage from an initial melee target to targets up to 2 hexes behind. <style="Stat_Hits">{[nrOfHits]}x</style> <style="DMG_Piercing">{[dmg[0]]} Piercing Damage</style> to first target, <style="Stat_Hits">{[nrOfHits]}x</style> <style="DMG_Piercing">{[dmg[1]]} Piercing Damage</style> to the second, and <style="Stat_Hits">{[nrOfHits]}x</style> <style="DMG_Piercing">{[dmg[2]]} Piercing Damage</style> to the third. Lands in the hex directly behind the last target hit, or - in case that hex is occupied - to the closest free hex to it.

{[S/AbilityDamageExplanation]}

LordOfTempests.description: <style="Faction_SpaceWolves">Njal</style>'s <style="NormalAttack">normal attacks</style> deal <style="Stat_Damage">+{[extraDmg]} Damage</style> for each hex surrounding him that is covered in <style="Effect_Ice">Ice</style>. The hex of each enemy that is hit by <style="Faction_SpaceWolves">Njal</style>'s normal attacks is covered in <style="Effect_Ice">Ice</style> at the end of the attack.

LordOfTheHost.description: Other friendly units within {[range]} hexes with <style="RapidAssault">Rapid Assault</style> or <style="Flying">Flying</style> deal <style="Stat_Damage">+{[extraDmg]} Damage</style> with melee attacks. Affected units that are at or below <style="Stat_Health">{[healthPct]}% Health</style> also score an additional <style="Stat_Hits">hit</style> with melee attacks.

MV71SniperDroneSquad.description:
Instead of a ranged attack, <style="Faction_Tau">Sho'syl</style> summons a <style="Summon">MV71 Sniper Drone</style> and commands it to attack the target. This attack uses <style="Faction_Tau">Sho'syl's</style> <style="Stat_Damage">Damage stat</style>, while other effects, like buffs, are taken from the Drone. If <style="Faction_Tau">Sho'syl</style> already controls {[maxSummons]} <style="Summon">MV71 Sniper Drones</style>, the one with the lowest <style="Stat_Health">Health</style> is removed before the new Drone is summoned.
The target also gains a <style="Debuff_Markerlight">Markerlight</style> until the end of <style="Faction_Tau">Sho'syl's</style> next turn.

MV71 Sniper Drones' stats:
<style="Stat_Health">{[summonHp]} Health</style>
<style="Stat_Damage">{[summonDmg]} Damage</style>
<style="Stat_Armor">{[summonArmor]} Armour</style>

MalleusRocketLauncher.description:
Marks a hex on the battlefield. At the beginning of the <style="MoW"><style="Faction_AstraMilitarum">Field Ordnance Battery</style></style>'s next turn, it unleashes a barrage of missiles. {[nrOfProjectiles]} missiles impact on the marked hex and {[nrOfProjectiles_2]} missiles impact in hexes adjacent to the target with a maximum of {[nrOfProjectiles_3]} impacts per unit. Each impact deals <style="DMG_Blast">{[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Blast Damage</style> and all units hit get <style="Debuff_Pinned">Suppressed</style>. Enemies hit within {[range]} hexes of a friendly <style="Faction_AstraMilitarum">Astra Militarum</style> unit take <style="Stat">+{[extraDmg]}</style> damage from each hit.

Initial <style="Cooldown">cooldown: {[initialCooldownTurns]} round</style>. 
Cost: <style="Resource_MachinesOfWarAmmo">{[munitionsCost]} munition</style>.

{[S/AbilityDamageExplanation]}

MartialExemplar.description: Deals <style="Stat_Hits">{[nrOfHits]}x</style> <style={[DamageProfileTypeStyle]}>{[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} {[DamageProfileType]}</style> to all adjacent enemies. Then moves up to {[nrOfTiles]} hex towards the closest enemy unit and performs a <style="NormalAttack">normal attack</style>. These attacks and all further attacks this turn have <style="Stat">+{[extraCritChance]}% Crit Chance</style> against <style="Summon">Summons</style>.

MartialInspiration.description: Deals {[nrOfHits]}x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Eviscerating Damage to an adjacent enemy. This attack and attacks from Legacy of Combat this turn deal +{[extraDmgPct]}% Damage for each turn in which Kariyan performed an attack this battle. This ability can be used multiple times per battle but has a cooldown of {[cooldownTurns]} rounds.

MartialSuperiority.description: If <style="Faction_BlackTemplars">Brother Jaeger</style> gets targeted with a melee attack from an adjacent enemy during the enemy’s turn, he deals <style="Stat_Hits">{[nrOfHits]}x</style> <style="DMG_Power">{[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Power Damage</style> to the attacker before the enemy attack executes.

MassDriverAccelerator.description: Can only be used if <style="Faction_LeaguesOfVotann">Kîmm</style> has not moved. She and all friendly adjacent units have <style="Stat_Movement">+{[extraMovement]} Movement</style> until the end of this turn. Kîmm then charges a targeted enemy unit within movement range, dealing <style="Stat_Hits">{[nrOfHits]}x</style> <style="DMG_Direct">{[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Direct Damage</style> to the target and <style="Stat_Hits">{[nrOfHits_2]}x</style> <style="DMG_Physical">{[minDmg_2]}-{[maxDmg_2]} Physical Damage</style> to all enemies adjacent to the target.

MasterAnnihilator.description: When Vitruvius performs a normal attack against an enemy, that enemy is affected by Master Annihilator until Vitruvius is defeated or performs a normal attack against a different unit. Attacks by any friendly unit against the affected enemy score an additional hit, except attacks that deal Psychic Damage. This additional hit can deal a maximum of {[maxDmg]} Damage.

MasterOfTheTutelaries.description:
Summon a <style="Summon"><style="Faction_ThousandSons">Pink Horror</style></style> on a free hex adjacent to <style="Faction_ThousandSons">Abraxas</style>. Until the end of this turn, whenever an enemy unit is dealt <style="DMG_Psychic">Psychic Damage</style>, summon a <style="Summon2"><style="Faction_ThousandSons">Screamer of Tzeentch</style></style> on a free hex adjacent to <style="Faction_ThousandSons">Abraxas</style>, preferring hexes adjacent to enemy units. Newly summoned units can immediately attack an enemy in range but cannot move.

Pink Horror stats:
<style="Stat_Health">{[summonHp]} Health</style>
<style="Stat_Damage">{[summonDmg]} Damage</style>

Screamer of Tzeentch stats:
<style="Stat_Health">{[summonHp_2]} Health</style>
<style="Stat_Damage">{[summonDmg_2]} Damage</style>

MasterfulTactician.description: All friendly units that are adjacent to a friendly <style="Faction_DarkAngels">Dark Angel</style> deal <style="Stat_Damage">+{[extraDmg]} Damage</style> with all attacks. If they are adjacent to {[nrOfUnits]} or more friendly Dark Angels, they also score an additional <style="Stat_Hits">hit</style> with attacks that deal <style="DMG_Plasma">Plasma</style> Damage or are done while <style="Buff_Overwatching">Overwatching</style>.

MastersOfManoeuvre.description: Friendly <style="Rarity_Mythic">Mythic</style> <style="Character">characters</style> take <style="Stat_Damage">-{[dmgReductionPct]}% Damage</style> from ranged attacks until the start of their next turn if they have traversed {[tilesTraversed]} or more hexes during their turn or end their turn next to a friendly <style="Rarity_Mythic">Mythic</style> <style="Faction_DarkAngels">Dark Angel</style>.

Maugetar.description: During his turn, if <style="Faction_Aeldari">Maugan Ra</style> has not moved, he can move after attacking and his attacks that contain a <style="Stat_CritDamage">Crit</style> deal an additional <style="Stat_Hits">{[nrOfHits]}x</style> <style="DMG_Direct">{[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Direct Damage</style>. When <style="Buff_Overwatching">Overwatching</style>, <style="Stat_CritDamage">Crits</style> deal this additional <style="Stat_Hits">hit</style> if he has not moved in his last turn.

MawClawsOfThyrax.description: The relic bearer deals <style="Stat_CritDamage">+{[extraCritDmg]} Crit Damage</style> for each adjacent <style="Summon">Summon</style>.

MedicusMinistorum.description: Any friendly adjacent non-mechanical unit that takes <style="Stat_Damage">Damage</style> <style="Regenerate">regenerates</style> <style="Stat_Health">{[hpToHeal]} Health</style> afterwards, unless it is defeated.

MightFromBelow.description:
Deals <style="Stat_Hits">{[nrOfHits]}x</style> <style="DMG_Psychic">{[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Psychic Damage</style> to an adjacent enemy, then summons a <style="Summon"><style="Faction_Genestealers">Purestrain Genestealer</style></style> on each <style="Decoy">decoy</style> adjacent to <style="Faction_Genestealers">the Patermine</style>. The Purestrain Genestealers can immediately attack in <style="Stat_Melee">melee</style>, but cannot move this turn.

Purestrain Genestealer stats:
<style="Stat_Health">{[summonHp]} Health</style>
<style="Stat_Damage">{[summonDmg]} Damage</style>
<style="Stat_Armor">{[summonArmor]} Armour</style>

{[S/AbilityDamageExplanation]}

MindControl.description: Targets an enemy unit within {[range]} hexes that is adjacent to one or more friendly units. For this round and the next, that enemy unit deals <style="Stat_Damage">-{[dmgReduction]} Damage</style>, takes <style="Stat_Damage">+{[extraDmgPct]}% Damage</style>, and becomes <style="Debuff_Taunted">Taunted</style> by the adjacent unit with the highest current <style="Stat_Health">Health</style>.

MischiefMakers.description: Targets of the <style="Faction_DeathGuard">Nurglings'</style> <style="NormalAttack">normal attacks</style> cannot be revived, <style="Healing">healed</style>, <style="Repairing">repaired</style>, or otherwise restore {[S/Health]} for {[nrOfRounds]} round. These attacks additionally have a <style="Stat_Chance">{[chance]}% chance</style> to <style="Debuff_Pinned">Suppress</style> the target for {[nrOfRounds]} round.

ModifiedExoarmour.description: <style="Faction_LeaguesOfVotann">Kîmm</style> takes <style="Stat_Damage">-{[dmgReduction]} Damage</style> for each time she was attacked this turn. When Kîmm <style="Charging">charges</style> an enemy, all units with <style="PrioritisedEfficiency">Prioritised Efficiency</style> that traverse 3 or more hexes this turn deal <style="Stat_Damage">+{[extraDmgPct]}% Damage</style> until the end of this turn.

MomentShackle.description: <style="Faction_Custodes">Trajann</style> <style="Healing">heals</style> himself for <style="Stat_Health">{[hpToHeal]} Health</style>. For {[nrOfRounds]} round, <style="Faction_Custodes">Trajann</style> has <style="Stat_Chance">+{[blockChance]}% Block chance</style> and blocks an additional <style="Stat_Block">+{[blockDmg]} Damage</style>. During that round, he also deals <style="Stat_Hits">{[nrOfHits]}x</style> <style="DMG_Bolter">{[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Bolter Damage</style> to each enemy unit that moves from a hex adjacent to him.

MonsterSlayerOfCaliban.description: <style="Faction_DarkAngels">Forcas</style> deals <style="Stat_Damage">+{[extraDmg]} Damage</style> to <style="Big_Target">Big Targets</style> and <style="Vehicle">Vehicles</style>. He also has an added <style="Stat_Chance">{[blockChance]}% chance</style> to <style="Stat_Block">Block</style> <style="Stat_Damage">{[blockDmg]} Damage</style>.

MoreGitzOverEre.description: Enemies that are adjacent to a friendly <style="Faction_Orks">Squig</style> or adjacent to two or more friendly <style="Rarity_Mythic">Mythic</style> <style="Character">characters</style> take <style="Stat_Damage">+{[extraDmgPct]}% Damage</style> from <style="NormalAttack">normal melee attacks</style> by <style="Rarity_Mythic">Mythic</style> characters.

MortarionsPlagueWind.description:
Deals <style="Stat_Hits">{[nrOfHits]}x</style> <style="DMG_Psychic">{[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Psychic Damage</style> to a target within {[range]} hexes. Any enemies adjacent to the initial target take <style="Stat_Hits">{[nrOfHits]}x</style> <style="DMG_Psychic">{[minDmg_2]}-{[maxDmg_2]} Psychic Damage</style>. Any further enemies adjacent to at least one secondary target take <style="Stat_Hits">{[nrOfHits]}x</style> <style="DMG_Psychic">{[minDmg_3]}-{[maxDmg_3]} Psychic Damage</style>. <style="Summon">Summons</style> take double damage.

{[S/AbilityDamageExplanation]}

MortisRound.description:
Deals <style="Stat_Hits">1x</style> <style="DMG_Heavy">{[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Heavy Round Damage</style> to a single target within range 3, which is then <style="Displacement">pushed</style> back 1 hex.
The <style="Heavy_Weapon">Heavy Weapon</style> trait applies double to this ability.

MultiMelta.description:
Deals <style="Stat_Hits">{[nrOfHits]}x</style> <style={[DamageProfileTypeStyle]}>{[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} {[DamageProfileType]}</style> to an enemy in range {[range]}. This attack deals <style="Stat_Damage">+{[extraDmg]} Damage</style> if the target is in a surrounding hex. This ability can be used multiple times per battle but has a <style="Cooldown">cooldown of {[cooldownTurns]} rounds</style>.

<style="Cooldown">Initial cooldown: {[initialCooldownTurns]} round</style>.

MultiThreatEliminator.description: Deals <style="Stat_Hits">6x</style> <style="DMG_Gauss">{[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Molecular Damage</style> to an enemy within range {[range]}. Any leftover <style="Stat_Hits">hits</style> are allocated to another enemy adjacent to the target and in range {[range]}. Each enemy killed adds <style="Stat_Hits">+{[extraHit]} hit</style> and the ability keeps targeting new enemies until there are no more enemies or <style="Stat_Hits">hits</style> left.

MultiTracker.description: All enemy units that did not move during their turn receive a <style="Debuff_Markerlight">Markerlight</style>.

MurderousSwing.description: Deals <style="Stat_Hits">{[nrOfHits]}x</style> <style="DMG_Piercing">{[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Piercing Damage</style> to all adjacent enemies. If this attack only hits one enemy, it deals <style="Stat_Damage">+{[extraDmg]} Damage</style>.

MyWillBeDoneOverlord.description: At the end of <style="Faction_Necrons">Anuphet's</style> turn, a friendly adjacent <style="Mechanical">Mechanical</style> unit performs a <style="NormalAttack">normal attack</style> against a target in range, using <style="Stat">{[dmgPct]}%</style> of its own <style="Stat_Damage">Damage stat</style> to a maximum of <style="Stat_Damage">{[maxDmg]} Damage</style>. If no attack was performed this way, Anuphet gains <style="Stat_Damage">+{[extraDmg]} Damage</style> until the end of his next turn.

NanoscarabRepairProtocols.description: Targets a friendly mechanical unit that is not affected by Nanoscarab Repair Protocols. It is now affected by Nanoscarab Repair Protocols for the rest of the battle. The target immediately gains {[hp]} Health and its maximum Health increases by the same amount. When the affected unit regains Health, the amount it regains is increased by {[hpToRepair]} Health.

Narthecium.description: When an adjacent friendly non-<style="Mechanical">Mechanical</style> unit is defeated, it is immediately revived with a maximum of <style="Stat_Health">{[hp]} Health</style>, unless <style="Overkill">Overkilled</style>. Can only be triggered once per turn.

NetherRealmCasket.description: The relic bearer takes <style="Stat_CritDamage">-{[critDmgReduction]} Crit Damage</style> for each adjacent friendly <style="Mechanical">Mechanical</style> unit and <style="Regenerate">regenerates</style> an additional  <style="Stat_Health">{[hpToHeal]} Health</style> from <style="Living_Metal">Living Metal</style>.

Neuroparasite.description:
Each enemy that is dealt <style="DMG_Psychic">Psychic Damage</style> by the <style="Faction_Tyranids">Neurothrope</style> is infected by a <style="Debuff_Neuroparasite">Neuroparasite</style> until either the unit is healed or the <style="Faction_Tyranids">Neurothrope</style> is defeated. Whenever a unit infected with a <style="Debuff_Neuroparasite">Neuroparasite</style> takes <style="DMG_Psychic">Psychic Damage</style> or becomes affected by an attack or ability that would <style="Debuff_Pinned">Suppress</style> it, the level of the <style="Debuff_Neuroparasite">Neuroparasite</style> increases by 1, up to a maximum of <style="STAT">{[buffMaxLevel]}</style>.

<style="DMG_Psychic">Psychic Damage</style> dealt by the <style="Faction_Tyranids">Neurothrope</style> is increased by <style="Stat_Damage">+{[extraDmg]} Damage</style> for each level of a <style="Debuff_Neuroparasite">Neuroparasite</style> on the target.

Nightshroud.description: All friendly units starting their turn adjacent to <style="Faction_AstraMilitarum">Sibyll Devine</style> gain <style="Buff_Infiltrate">Infiltrate</style> for that turn and take <style="Stat_Damage">-{[dmgReduction]} Damage</style> from each hit in their and the next enemy turn.

NoHidingFromTheWatchers.description: Any <style="Stat_Damage">Damage</style> this unit takes is reduced to 0. After being attacked, this unit moves {[nrOfTiles]} hex, trying to move away from all other units. If there is no other friendly <style="Faction_DarkAngels">Dark Angel</style> on the battlefield except other <style="Faction_DarkAngels">Watchers in the Dark</style>, then this unit leaves the battlefield.

NornCrown.description: The maximum level of <style="Debuff_Neuroparasite">Neuroparasite</style> is increased by {[effectLevel]}. Other friendly <style="Psyker">Psykers</style> within <style="Synapse">Synapse</style> range and friendly <style="Summon">Summons</style> within <style="Synapse">Synapse</style> range deal <style="Stat_Damage">+{[extraDmg]} Damage</style> to enemies that are affected by <style="Debuff_Neuroparasite">Neuroparasite</style>.

NovaBoost.description: Marks all hexes adjacent to the <style="Faction_Tau">Riptide</style>. <style="Tile_Trench">Trenches</style> cannot be marked. At the beginning of its next turn, the Riptide deals <style="Stat_Hits">{[nrOfHits]}x</style> <style="DMG_Particle">{[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Particle Damage</style> to each enemy on marked hexes and then flies to a new location on the battlefield.

NovaCharge.description: Faces in one of 6 directions and marks all hexes in a 3-tile wide line, originating from the <style="Faction_Tau">Riptide</style> and additionally marks {[nrOfTargets]} hexes that are not on this line. <style="Tile_Trench">Trenches</style> cannot be marked. At the beginning of the Riptide's next turn, it deals <style="Stat_Hits">{[nrOfHits]}x</style> <style="DMG_Particle">{[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Particle Damage</style> to all enemies on the hexes marked by the line, and <style="Stat_Hits">{[nrOfHits_2]}x</style> <style="DMG_Blast">{[minDmg_2]}-{[maxDmg_2]} Blast Damage</style> to all enemies on the other marked hexes.

NovaShield.description: The <style="Faction_Tau">Riptide</style> gains a <style="Buff_Shield">Shield</style> with <style="Stat_Health">{[shieldHp]} Health</style> and receives <style="Stat_Chance">+{[blockChance]}% Block chance</style> for {[nrOfRounds]} round. It then marks a hex on the battlefield and all hexes adjacent to it. <style="Tile_Trench">Trenches</style> cannot be marked. At the beginning of its next turn, the Riptide deals <style="Stat_Hits">{[nrOfHits]}x</style> <style="DMG_Particle">{[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Particle Damage</style> to all enemies on marked hexes.

ObsessiveAnnunciation.description: All enemy units adjacent to <style="Faction_EmperorsChildren">Adamatar</style> take <style="Stat_Damage">+{[extraDmg]} Damage</style> from ranged attacks. If an enemy was <style="Overkill">Overkilled</style> this turn, enemies adjacent to Adamatar take <style="Stat_CritDamage">+{[extraCritDmg]} Crit Damage</style> from all attacks by friendly <style="Aliance_Chaos">Chaos</style> units.

OiWatchIt.description: When this unit is attacked, a <style="Steppable">steppable</style> crate of <style="Resource_Gold">Coins</style> is spawned in a free adjacent hex for each hit taken.

OmnissiahsBlessing.description: Whenever the <style="Faction_AdeptusMechanicus">Tech-Priest Enginseer</style> <style="Repairing">repairs</style> another unit, it transfers all levels of <style="Buff_MachineVengeance">Machine Vengeance</style> it has to the repaired unit.

OnMyPosition.description: Enemies that are adjacent to a friendly <style="Faction_AstraMilitarum">Cadian Guardsman</style> or a friendly <style="Rarity_Mythic">Mythic</style> <style="Character">character</style> take <style="Stat_Damage">+{[extraDmgPct]}% Damage</style> from ranged attacks by mythic characters.

OptimizedGait.description: Whenever an enemy adjacent to <style="Faction_AdeptusMechanicus">Exitor-Rho</style> is attacked by another friendly <style="Mechanical">Mechanical</style> unit, <style="Faction_AdeptusMechanicus">Exitor-Rho</style> deals <style="Stat_Hits">{[nrOfHits]}x</style> <style="DMG_Energy">{[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Energy Damage</style> to that enemy. If an enemy adjacent to <style="Faction_AdeptusMechanicus">Exitor-Rho</style> is defeated by a friendly <style="Mechanical">Mechanical</style> unit or an attack triggered from this ability, <style="Faction_AdeptusMechanicus">Exitor-Rho</style> moves onto its hex.

OrbsOfDecay.description: The relic bearer's <style="NormalAttack">normal attacks</style> deal an additional <style="Stat_Hits">{[nrOfHits]}x</style> <style="DMG_Toxic">{[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Toxic Damage</style> to enemy units that have their <style="Stat_Armor">Armour</style> reduced by {[armorReductionPct]}% or more and are also on or adjacent to the target's hex. Additionally, the target's hex is <style="Tile_Contamination">Contaminated</style>.

OverwhelmingWrath.description: Until the beginning of his next turn <style="Faction_WorldEaters">Azkor</style> <style="Debuff_Taunted">Taunts</style> all adjacent enemies and takes <style="Stat_Damage">-{[dmgReductionPct]}% Damage</style> from ranged attacks. Deals <style="Stat_Hits">{[nrOfHits]}x</style> <style="DMG_Eviscerate">{[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Eviscerating Damage</style> to all adjacent enemies at the beginning of <style="Faction_WorldEaters">Azkor's</style> next turn.

ParagonSpear.description: All of <style="Faction_Custodes">Tyrith's</style> hits that are <style="Stat_CritDamage">Crits</style> deal the maximum possible <style="Stat_Damage">Damage</style>. At the beginning of Tyrith's turn, she attacks a random enemy within range {[range]} and deals <style="Stat_Hits">{[nrOfHits]}x</style> <style="DMG_Bolter">{[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Bolter Damage</style> to it. If there is an enemy adjacent to her, this range is reduced to 1.

PathOfCommand.description: Other friendly units within {[range]} hexes gain <style="Stat_Damage">+{[extraDmg]} Damage</style>. Their <style="Stat_CritDamage">Crit <style="Stat_Chance">chance</style></style> – if they have one – is increased by <style="Stat">+{[extraCritChance]}%</style>. Affected <style="Faction_Aeldari">Aeldari</style> units gain an additional <style="Stat_Damage">+{[extraDmg_2]} Damage</style>.

PhasalSubjugator.description: After moving, if there is no friendly Necron Warrior on the battlefield, Anuphet summons a Necron Warrior in a free adjacent hex. If Anuphet does not move, this ability triggers at the end of his turn. After My Will Be Done triggers, it triggers a second time, but only a friendly adjacent Necron Warrior that was not affected by it this turn can perform an attack. The Necron Warriors have {[summonHp]} Health, {[summonDmg]} Damage and {[summonArmor]} Armour.

PhoenixGem.description: The first time each battle that <style="Faction_Aeldari">Aethana</style> is defeated, she is instead revived with a maximum of <style="Stat_Health">{[hp]} Health</style> remaining, even if <style="Overkill">Overkilled</style>.

PileIn.description:
If this unit has full <style="Stat_Health">Health</style> at the end of its turn, it has a {[chance]}% chance to <style="Summon">summon</style> another <style="Faction_Orks">Grot</style> in an adjacent free hex, -{[chance_2]}% for each friendly <style="Faction_Orks">Grot</style> currently on the board. The spawned <style="Faction_Orks">Grot</style> acts as normal on its next turn.

Grot’s stats:
<style="Stat_Health">{[summonHp]} Health</style>
<style="Stat_Damage">{[summonDmg]} Damage</style>

PlagueWind.description:
Deals <style="Stat_Hits">{[nrOfHits]}x</style><style="DMG_Psychic">{[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Psychic Damage</style> to a target within {[range]} hexes. Any enemies adjacent to the initial target take <style="Stat_Hits">{[nrOfHits]}x</style> <style="DMG_Psychic">{[minDmg_2]}-{[maxDmg_2]} Psychic Damage</style>. Any further enemies adjacent to at least one secondary target take <style="Stat_Hits">{[nrOfHits]}x</style> <style="DMG_Psychic">{[minDmg_3]}-{[maxDmg_3]} Psychic Damage</style>.

{[S/AbilityDamageExplanation]}

PlasmaCannon.description:
Deals <style="Stat_Hits">{[nrOfHits]}x</style> <style="DMG_Plasma">{[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Plasma Damage</style> to an enemy within range {[range]} and up to two enemy units behind the target. This ability can be used multiple times per battle but has a <style="Cooldown">cooldown of {[cooldownTurns]} round.</style> 

<style="Cooldown">Initial cooldown: {[initialCooldownTurns]} round</style>.

PlasmaGrenade.description:
Throws a grenade at a target within {[range]} hexes, dealing <style="Stat_Hits">{[nrOfHits]}x</style> <style="DMG_Plasma">{[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Plasma Damage</style> to it and <style="Stat_Hits">{[nrOfHits_2]}x</style> <style="DMG_Plasma">{[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Plasma Damage</style> to enemy units in adjacent hexes. This ability benefits from <style="Indirect_Fire">Indirect Fire</style>.

{[S/AbilityDamageExplanation]}

Possession.description:
Each time <style="Faction_BlackLegion">Archimatos</style> kills an enemy unit with a melee attack, he summons a <style="Summon"><style="Faction_BlackLegion">Bloodletter</style></style> in its hex. Each time he kills an enemy unit with a ranged attack, he summons a <style="Summon2"><style="Faction_ThousandSons">Blue Horror</style></style> in its hex.

PowerTrip.description: <style="NormalAttack">Normal attacks</style> ignore <style="Stat_Armor">{[armorIgnored]} Armour</style>. If <style="Faction_Orks">Snappawrecka</style> is at full <style="Stat_Health">Health</style>, his <style="NormalAttack">normal attacks</style> additionally score <style="Stat_Hits">+{[extraHit]} hit</style> and reduce the target's Armour by <style="Stat_Armor">{[armorReduction]} Armour</style>, but also cause <style="Faction_Orks">Snappawrecka</style> to lose <style="Stat">{[hpPct]}%</style> of his maximum <style="Stat_Health">Health</style>.

PowerUp_Armor.description: When picked up by a unit, this power-up increases their <style="Stat_Armor">Armour</style> by an amount equal to {[healthPct]}% of their max <style="Stat_Health">Health</style>.

PowerUp_Bomb.description: When picked up by a friendly unit, triggers an explosion that deals <style="Stat_Hits">{[nrOfHits]}x</style> <style="DMG_Blast">{[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Blast Damage</style> to all enemies within {[range]} hexes of the pick-up hex. The damage is increased at higher rarity tiers.

PowerUp_Damage.description: When picked up by a unit, this power-up increases their <style="Stat_Damage">Damage</style> by {[dmgPct]}%.

PowerUp_Healing.description: When picked up by a unit, this power-up <style="Healing">heals</style> that unit for {[HealPercentage]}% of their max <style="Stat_Health">Health</style>.

PowerUp_Health.description: When picked up by a unit, this power-up increases their <style="Stat_Health">Health</style> by an amount equal to {[healthPct]}% of their max <style="Stat_Health">Health</style>.

PowerUp_HeroSpawn_BladeChampion.description: When picked up by a friendly unit, deploys <style="Faction_Custodes">Kariyan</style> onto the battlefield. They can be controlled like other friendly <style="Character">characters</style>. If possible, they try to deploy onto the hex of an enemy unit, and the enemy on that hex is <style="Obliterated">always overkilled</style>.

PowerUp_HeroSpawn_Uthar.description: When picked up by a friendly unit, deploys <style="Faction_LeaguesOfVotann">Uthar</style> onto the battlefield. They can be controlled like other friendly <style="Character">characters</style>. If possible, they try to deploy onto the hex of an enemy unit, and the enemy on that hex is <style="Obliterated">always overkilled</style>.

PowerUp_HeroSpawn_VexilusPraetor.description: When picked up by a friendly unit, deploys <style="Faction_Custodes">Aesoth</style> onto the battlefield. They can be controlled like other friendly <style="Character">characters</style>. If possible, they try to deploy onto the hex of an enemy unit, and the enemy on that hex is <style="Obliterated">always overkilled</style>.

PowerUp_Hits.description: When picked up by a unit, this power-up increases the number of <style="Stat_Hits">hits</style> on their attacks by +{[extraHit]}.

PowerUp_MeleeHits.description: When picked up by a unit, this power-up increases the number of <style="Stat_Hits">hits</style> on their <style="Stat_Melee">melee</style> attack by +{[extraHit]}.

PowerUp_ReactivateAbility.description: When picked up by a unit, this power-up allows them to use their active ability again during the ongoing battle.

PowerUp_Reinforcement.description: Adds 1 Reinforcement point when picked up by a friendly unit.

PowerUp_ReinforcementShield.description: When picked up by a unit, each deployed character in this event will deploy with a <style="Buff_Shield">Shield</style> equal to {[shieldPct]}% of their max <style="Stat_Health">Health</style>. The shield strength accumulates with each additional Shield power-up you pick up.

PowerUp_Resurrect.description:
When picked up by a friendly unit, resurrects a chosen <style="Character">character</style> that has been defeated. The resurrected character spawns in a random free hex and can immediately take a turn. 

If there is no eligible character,  it adds 1 Reinforcement point instead.

Deals +{[extraDmg_2]} Damage to enemy units for each Waaagh! charge Zapspitta has. Poxwalkers.description:
Summons <style="Summon"><style="Faction_DeathGuard">Poxwalkers</style></style> in <style="Stat_Chance">{[chance]}-{[chance_2]}%</style> of free hexes (rounded up) within <style="Faction_DeathGuard">Corrodius'</style> <style="ContagionsOfNurgle">Contagion</style> aura. Newly summoned <style="Summon"><style="Faction_DeathGuard">Poxwalkers</style></style> immediately attack in <style="Stat_Melee">melee</style>, but cannot move this turn.

PreCalibratedPurgeSolution.description: If <style="Faction_AdeptusMechanicus">Belisarius Cawl</style> has at least <style="Stat">{[effectLevel]}</style> levels of <style="Buff_MachineVengeance">Machine Vengeance</style> at the start of his turn, he deals <style="Stat_Hits">{[nrOfHits]}x</style> <style="DMG_Toxic">{[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Toxic Damage</style> to all enemies on the battlefield.

PrecisionShot.description: The Deathmark neither moves nor attacks for a turn, but instead takes aim. On its next turn, it is not allowed to move, but is able to fire its Synaptic Disintegrator with incredible accuracy, dealing <style="Stat_Hits">{[nrOfHits]}x</style> <style="DMG_Energy">{[dmg]} Energy Damage</style>.

PredictiveGuidance.description: Enemies within 2 hexes of Âmmuk are affected by Predictive Guidance. If an affected enemy did not move in its last turn, other friendly Leagues of Votann or Mechanical units deal +{[extraDmg]} Damage with melee attacks against it. If an affected enemy moved in its last turn, other friendly Leagues of Votann or Mechanical units deal +{[extraDmg_2]} Damage with ranged attacks against it. Other friendly Leagues of Votann units also score an additional hit with all attacks against affected enemies.

PrehensilePincerTail.description: When the Hive Tyrant attacks an enemy in melee, that target or an enemy unit adjacent to both the target and the Hive Tyrant takes <style="Stat_Hits">{[nrOfHits]}x</style> <style="DMG_Physical">{[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Physical Damage</style>.

PrimarchOfTheFirstLegion.description: Half of the <style="Stat_Hits">hits</style> (rounded down) scored against <style="Faction_DarkAngels">Lion El'Jonson</style> are scored against other friendly adjacent <style="Faction_DarkAngels">Dark Angels</style> instead. Friendly Dark Angels that take <style="Stat_Damage">Damage</style> this way deal <style="Stat_Damage">+{[extraDmg]} Damage</style> for {[nrOfRounds]} round.

PrimeTestSubject.description: Heals an adjacent friendly unit for {[hpToHeal]} Health and Augments it. An Augmented unit gains +{[extraDmg]} Damage and +{[hp]} maximum Health, but loses {[hpPct]}% of its maximum Health at the end of each of its turns. If the Augmented unit is Chaos, it also gains +{[extraMovement]} Movement. When the Augmented unit is defeated or leaves the battlefield, this ability can be used again.

PropheticSentinel.description: Adjacent friendly <style="Aliance_Chaos">Chaos</style> units have <style="Stat_Armor">+{[extraArmor]} Armour</style>. Adjacent friendly <style="Psyker">Psykers</style> have <style="Stat_Chance">+{[blockChance]}% Block chance</style> and block <style="Stat_Block">+{[blockDmg]} Damage</style>. At the end of its turn, if the <style="Faction_ThousandSons">Sekhetar Robot</style> is adjacent to a friendly Psyker, it starts <style="Buff_Overwatching">Overwatching</style>, even if it attacked during its turn.

PsychicFortress.description: All friendly surrounding units have an added <style="Stat_Block">Block</style> with <style="Stat_Chance">{[blockChance]}% chance</style> to block <style="Stat_Damage">{[blockDmg]} Damage</style>. Also reduces incoming <style="DMG_Psychic">Psychic Damage</style> by {[dmgReduction]}.
